'''Darvannis''' was a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] where the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] ostensibly built up its military forces during the [[Galactic War]]. When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] attempted to intervene, they found the renegade [[Dread Masters|Dread Master]] [[Styrak]] attempting to gather the forces at Darvannis to serve the Masters' [[Dread Host]] instead. After Styrak's defeat in [[Battle of Darvannis|battle]], the [[Eternal Empire]] [[Invasion of Darvannis|occupied]] Darvannis, where they produced [[Skytrooper]]s and advanced [[GEMINI]] units to ensure their [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]] of the galaxy. The opposing [[Eternal Alliance]] subsequently [[Raid on Darvannis|raided]] the [[Darvannis factory|factory]] and captured the [[GEMINI Prime]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]].

==Description==
Darvannis was an arid<ref name="Codex" /> desert world<ref name="KotFE" /> located in the [[Calaron sector/Legends|Calaron sector]]. It was devoid of any valuable natural resources or native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Furthermore, a dense [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] made any approach to the planet difficult. For those reasons, Darvannis was little visited by offworlders.<ref name="Codex" />

[[File:Darvannis_landscape.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Darvannis landscape]]
The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] built prosperous market villas on the planet that prospered through the illegal trade of weapons and other black market goods. Darvannis thus became an appreciated retreat for members of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], especially for those wishing to avoid attention.<ref name="Codex" /> [[Oasis City]] was located on the planet surface.<ref name="SaV" />

==History==
{{Quote|A vast assembly of mercenary and pirate arms, vehicles, and personnel was gathered on Darvannis, ostensibly to vie for Cartel contracts. Instead, the Dread Master known as Styrak attempted to overwhelm and convert the mercenaries into service among the Dread Host|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]]|<ref name="ARotDM">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20130913|text=A Record of the Dread Masters}}</ref>}}
[[File:Oasis_City_2.png|thumb|right|250px|Oasis City, Darvannis]]
Darvannis was discovered by [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] about five centuries before the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="Codex" /> During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Hutt Cartel assembled a significant army of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] on Darvannis. Concerned about the army, both the Republic and the Empire dispatched strike teams to eliminate the threat. During the [[Battle of Darvannis|battle]], they discovered that the mercenaries were in fact gathered by the renegade [[Dread Masters|Dread Master]] [[Styrak]] in order to convert them into service among the [[Dread Host]]. Styrak and all the mercenaries, including the four Cartel [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] [[Horic]], [[Vilus Garr|Vilus]], [[Sunder (mercenary)|Sunder]], and [[Tu'chuk]], were eventually defeated.<ref name="SaV" />

Later, when the [[Eternal Empire]] [[Eternal Empire conquest|invaded]] the galaxy, Darvannis was one of the first worlds to be [[Invasion of Darvannis|conquered]]. Under the rule of [[Zakuul]], Darvannis was home to a [[Skytrooper]] [[Darvannis factory|droid factory]]. During the [[Eternal Alliance]]'s [[war against Zakuul]], the [[Alliance Commander]] and [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] forces [[Raid on Darvannis|raided]] the factory and captured the droid [[GEMINI Prime]].<ref name="KotFE" />
